notes.title: Scroll of Beasts
notes.content:
[p][i]As the world teeters on the edge of oblivion, it’s not fire or famine that greets you first on the path—it’s the faces. Twisted. Masked. Forgotten. Sancticide’s world may be stalled in the End Times, but its horrors are anything but static.
[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png"][/img][/p][p]
With each major patch on the road to 1.0, [b]we’ve reshaped what stands between you and final judgment[/b]. Some enemies have been reforged, others emerged from the darkness for the first time. Each has a story. A purpose. A design, often divine, always broken.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/212df16e03567ec7eb6b8525a1dd85298a3f6157.png"][/img]
[/p][p]🔔 [b]Ringer[/b]  - Once a common foe, now rebuilt to resist the old tactic of spamming strikes and powers. 
[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/7670ba264c36a605042d205a053aa87947b38aa4.png"][/img]
[/p][p] 🪓 [b]Viscerator[/b] - A walking error of judgment. Four men fused into one abomination, wrapped in crude armor and armed with whatever sharp, heavy metal was lying around. The math didn’t add up, but the blood certainly does.[/p][p]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/f292602f8dedcd9580e0e2ebe22b94036d8905f8.png"][/img] [/p][p]
📿 [b]Reliquary[/b] - Cloaked in relics and fragments of sacred iconography, this Purple user channels the will of forgotten angels, but bows to no one, not even the Sin Collector.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/fe82f2e1944689b3a0df1dc12737f8362c86a424.png"][/img]
[/p][p] 👁️‍🗨️ [b]Dybbuk[/b] - Possession incarnate. When the host is broken, the demonic cloud leaves only to seek a new one. Kill fast, or risk becoming its next shell.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png"][/img][/p][p]
And these are just the visible scars on the body of the world. Behind the curtain, more beasts boil in the mire. [b]Each update brings new creatures, new challenges, [/b]and new reworks driven by [b]your feedback, reports, and even your frustrations[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]We're not done yet.[/p][p][/p][p]⚔️ [b]More enemies are coming.[/b] Some will crawl out of the Reversed side of reality. Some will descend from what’s left of the Heavens. And some-well, some were always here, just waiting.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for walking this road with us. The apocalypse is far from over, but every step, patch, and encounter gets us closer to the world we want Sancticide to be.[/p][p]💀 [i]Sharpen your blade.
[/i]👁️ [i]Stay watchful.
[/i]📜 [i]Please check back soon, as the judgment is still in progress.

- Red Square Games Team[/i][/p]

[list]
[*] Combat tweaks & visual polish

[*] Quality of life changes

[*] Community-driven bug fixes and performance updates
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png[/img]

⚠ Important: Please note that [u][b]previous save files may not be compatible[/b][/u] with this patch.
Your feedback continues to shape Sancticide. 

[h3]Dive into the new content, and if you’re enjoying your experience, please consider leaving us a positive Steam review—every review goes a long way in helping our small team grow.
[/h3]

Thanks for crossing the Storm Front with us,

 — The Red Square Games Team

notes.title: The Lore of Sancticide
notes.content:
[b]Sancticide[/b] is a game deeply rooted in rich and complex lore, drawn from the acclaimed Polish book series "Komornik" by Michał Gołkowski. The world we have crafted is a direct extension of this unique setting, and we hope this article will help clarify the time period and the many unusual elements within the game—including why you’ll see references to the Roman Empire while wielding firearms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/84e6a2b67368ff4fe0831d68009b92109c6b6d94.png[/img]

[b]The Apocalypse arrived[/b]—real, Biblical, and catastrophic. The Earth stopped spinning, the stars fell from the sky, and the oceans turned to blood. The dead rose, the heavens burned, and the great cataclysms foretold by St. John came to pass. The world was supposed to end.

But something went wrong.

The divine plan was flawless on parchment, but the reality of humanity proved far more complicated. 
The world had changed too much since the time of the prophecies. There were too many people and too much technological progress—mortals had outpaced the ancient divine machinery. 

The Four Horsemen’s chariots couldn’t outrun bicycles, let alone modern vehicles. Most importantly, people simply refused to die as expected.

What was meant to be an apocalyptic inferno became an agonizing limbo, a stillborn End of Days that neither concluded nor relented. 

The Angels of Death wandered as the Earth decayed slowly, caught in an endless twilight of suffering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/dbc2936f01b0c373d15568bead941c835a184b9e.png[/img]

Realizing that the End had gone off-script, divine forces sought a solution. Thus, the Apocryphal Angels were created—an unprecedented break from sacred doctrine. Their mission was simple: complete the Apocalypse, finalize the liquidation of Earth, and shut it all down for good.

But these new celestial bureaucrats, partly shaped by human thinking, were uninspired by their task. Lacking motivation and proper guidance, they outsourced the work to lesser contractors. 

These contractors, in turn, recruited executioners from among mortals—men and women who had abandoned their past lives to become the [b]Sin Collectors[/b].

Sin Collectors are the enforcers of divine will, hunting down sinners and wiping away what remains of the unKosher world. But what is ‘Kosher’ in this broken world?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/72a2d73999f0703e5bf17b7d0c72d5d626060ffc.png[/img]

[b]The new divine order decreed that all things must remain as they were at the fall of the Roman Empire[/b]—for that was the last era deemed righteous. 

Anything invented after that period is an abomination: cars, modern clothing, electronics, and even names and concepts not found in the Holy Book. 

Cities, streets, and entire ways of life are condemned as blasphemous. Humanity itself is a liability to be erased.

Sin Collectors should wield only ‘[b]Kosher[/b]’ weaponry—swords, axes, spears—though powered by sacred Purpleness, an ancient and terrifying force. Under the watchful gaze of their Guardian Angels, they walk the scorched lands, attempting to complete what the celestial host could not: the purification and final destruction of the world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/798d1631d41a27633202d96b1912e2ccd788b8cb.png[/img]

Yet, even in oblivion, not all accept their fate. The remnants of humanity resist in hidden pockets while heretical figures like Severius rise, challenging the celestial decree. 

Sin Collectors may enforce the End, but the battle for the world's final days is far from over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png[/img]

This is the world of Sancticide—a world teetering between the old and the new, between divine will and human defiance.

🔥 Join the battle. The End is here. 🔥

Sancticide is available in Early Access—wishlist now or dive in today!

notes.content:
Greetings, Sin Collectors!

The End of Days is upon us... but at last, the wait is over! The time of reckoning has been revealed—Sancticide will launch into [b]Steam Early Access on February 12, 2025![/b]

Sharpen your blades, steel your resolve, and prepare to walk the path of divine judgment. As the newly anointed collector of sins, Ezechiel, you will fight through the crumbling remains of the world, where saints and sinners battle for survival. With each enemy defeated, and every death endured, you’ll learn more and uncover the deeper mysteries of the apocalypse.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png[/img]

[b]What Awaits You in Early Access?
[/b]

🔥 [b]Brutal Third-Person Combat[/b] – A fusion of old-school arena fighter intensity and modern action mechanics.
⚔️ [b]A Holy & Unholy Arsenal[/b] – Wield divine and forbidden weapons, ranged tools, and reality-bending “Purple Powers.”
🙏 [b]The Kosherness System[/b] – Your actions and items determine your place in this ruined world, unlocking or restricting access to quests and NPCs and enemy unit reactions.
💀 [b]Roguelite Progression[/b] – Learn from death, adapt your strategies, and face ever-changing threats as you fight through the apocalypse again and again.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/4c68b76eb376099b4c26c1dae3e81c817fedbe09.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44904458/5a7ec066cdd4ba252273e4739a8939c4db950c89.png[/img]

Prepare for the Reckoning

We know you’ve been waiting for this moment, and we can't wait to share Sancticide with you. The Early Access release is just the beginning—we’ll be actively improving the game with your feedback, fine-tuning balance, expanding content, and making this experience as apocalyptic and intense as possible.

If you’re eager to dive into this world before the release, our [b]free demo[/b] is still available on Steam! Try it out, let us know your thoughts, and help shape the game before launch.

The clock is ticking, Sin Collectors. The Final Judgment begins on [b]February 12, 2025[/b]. Are you ready?

🔔 Add Sancticide to your wishlist and prepare for the End!

notes.title: Steam Next Fest - Try Santicide Demo
notes.content:
[h3]Greetings, Sin Collectors…[/h3]

The End Times await you. The demo for Sancticide is now available on Steam. Embark on a dark journey through an apocalyptic world and become a Sin Collector!

Sancticide is a melee-focused TPP action game with rogue-lite elements, set in a world of the biblical Apocalypse. The combat system based on spatial and directional awareness pays homage to the games of yore while manipulating the environment and physically interacting with it expands tactical possibilities.

The unique, twisted setting serves as a backdrop to the tale of Ezechiel - a fresh recruit to the Sin Collector Corps, haunted by remorse and guilt as he embarks on one of his most important missions yet. Explore the unforgiving world in which death is not the end, but merely another beginning.

KEY FEATURES:

[list]
[*] Unique Combat System: A hybrid of arena fighters and TPP action, featuring direction-based attacks, organic combos, and a diverse array of melee/ranged weapons and powers.
[*] Sin Collector Powers: Harness "Purple" powers to manipulate space, time, and objects, with both passive and active abilities to influence combat.
[*] Enemy Differentiation: Each enemy has distinct traits, helping players quickly gauge strengths, weaknesses, and movement styles.
[*] Death as Progress: Death isn’t just punishment—it’s a learning experience, allowing players to adapt and evolve in a persistent world.
[*] Kosherness: Items and beings are classified as Kosher or unKosher, affecting sidequests, relationships, equipment, and access to certain areas.
[*] Story & Sidequests: Follow Ezechiel's trials during the apocalypse, exploring themes of suffering, hope, and the daily life of a Sin Collector.
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Trailer Reveal
notes.content:
Greetings, Sin Collectors…

Today, we’re excited to share the new gameplay trailer for Sancticide! Step into the grim world of the End Times and become the Sin Collector.

[previewyoutube=vGNgy91oRnU;full][/previewyoutube]

We have more great news—Sancticide's demo will be available during Steam Next Fest! You’ll be able to step into Ezekiel’s shoes and face the apocalypse as early as next Monday. Get ready to be part of the end!

KEY FEATURES:

[list]
[*]Unique Combat System: A hybrid of arena fighters and TPP action, featuring direction-based attacks, organic combos, and a diverse array of melee/ranged weapons and powers.
[*]Sin Collector Powers: Harness "Purple" powers to manipulate space, time, and objects, with both passive and active abilities to influence combat.
[*]Enemy Differentiation: Each enemy has distinct traits, helping players quickly gauge strengths, weaknesses, and movement styles.
[*]Death as Progress: Death isn’t just punishment—it’s a learning experience, allowing players to adapt and evolve in a persistent world.
[*]Kosherness: Items and beings are classified as Kosher or unKosher, affecting sidequests, relationships, equipment, and access to certain areas.
[*]Story & Sidequests: Follow Ezechiel's trials during the apocalypse, exploring themes of suffering, hope, and the daily life of a Sin Collector.
[/list]
